title: The exceptional locus of a motivic local system
summary: To every Nori motivic local system over a smooth, connected complex algebraic variety, we associate an exceptional locus controlling the variation in the complexity of its stalks; the definition is given explicitly in terms of motivic Galois groups and Artin motives. We prove a motivic analogue of the Cattani--Deligne--Kaplan Theorem, asserting that the exceptional locus is a countable union of closed algebraic subvarieties.
